People say they leak but mines 13 years old and it has never had a problem. A lot of people have the misconception that the sunroof is intended to seal water tight when closed. For properly designed factory sunroofs the seal doesn't have to be perfect. In fact the seal tends to be there more for cutting down wind noise rather than stopping water. There should be a built-in gutter/drain around the perimeter of the sunroof which catches and redirects any water that gets in. If your factory sunroof leaks its probably because the drain tube has become clogged. Once you clear the tube everything should be fine again.

Now after market roofs, they don't tend to have the benefity of built it drains and will probably eventually leak.
